description: Length-matched fresh non-member control (v2) for the contamination check. Question/gold-SQL pairs authored 2026-10-19 over the SAME seven BIRD dev databases as v1, with gold-SQL token lengths drawn to BIRD's own distribution over the n=300 seed=0 draw: mean 54.05, median 51. These strings did not exist before this date and cannot be in any pretraining corpus. Every sql executes against dev_databases/<db_id>/<db_id>.sqlite and returns rows. v1 (bench/contamination_fresh.json, mean 21.2 tokens) is kept in place as the record of the defect this set repairs.

pairs.name: freshv2-000
pairs.question: How many heroes have amber eyes?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE eye_colour_id = 2

pairs.name: freshv2-001
pairs.question: How many molecules are labelled as carcinogenic?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule AS T1 WHERE T1.label = '+'

pairs.name: freshv2-002
pairs.question: How many gas stations belong to chain 3?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations AS T1 WHERE T1.ChainID = 3

pairs.name: freshv2-003
pairs.question: How many patients in the cohort are male?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'

pairs.name: freshv2-004
pairs.question: How many schools are run by a county office of education?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS T1 WHERE T1.SOCType = 'County Community'

pairs.name: freshv2-005
pairs.question: How many gas stations in Slovakia belong to the chain with the most stations in the sample?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations AS T1 WHERE T1.Country = 'SVK' AND T1.ChainID = (SELECT ChainID FROM gasstations GROUP BY ChainID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

pairs.name: freshv2-006
pairs.question: How many schools in Los Angeles County were chartered and directly funded?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County = 'Los Angeles' AND Charter = 1 AND FundingType = 'Directly funded'

pairs.name: freshv2-007
pairs.question: Which members attended the officers meeting held in April 2020?
pairs.sql: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name FROM attendance AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T1.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T3.event_name = 'Officers meeting - April'

pairs.name: freshv2-008
pairs.question: Which DC Comics heroes have the power Mind Control?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name, T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Mind Control' AND T1.publisher_id IN (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics')

pairs.name: freshv2-009
pairs.question: List the molecules in which a carbon atom is joined by a double bond.
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '=' AND T3.element = 'c'

pairs.name: freshv2-010
pairs.question: Which drivers finished on the podium at the 2014 Belgian Grand Prix?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.name = 'Belgian Grand Prix' AND T3.year = 2014 AND T2.positionOrder <= 3

pairs.name: freshv2-011
pairs.question: Which customer segment bought the most fuel at the stations of chain 3?
pairs.sql: SELECT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.GasStationID IN (SELECT GasStationID FROM gasstations WHERE ChainID = 3) GROUP BY T2.Segment ORDER BY SUM(T1.Amount) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: freshv2-012
pairs.question: Which patients were diagnosed with MCTD and also have a recorded symptom of AMI on their examination record?
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND T2.Symptoms = 'AMI'

pairs.name: freshv2-013
pairs.question: What is the total income recorded for the member whose first name is Angela and last name Sanders?
pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(T2.amount) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

pairs.name: freshv2-014
pairs.question: Which aliens have the power Super Strength?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien' AND T1.id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id IN (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength'))

pairs.name: freshv2-015
pairs.question: For each molecule label, how many single bonds exist in molecules carrying that label?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.label, COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY T1.label

pairs.name: freshv2-016
pairs.question: How many points did McLaren score in total across the 2013 season?
pairs.sql: SELECT SUM(T1.points) FROM constructorResults AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN constructors AS T3 ON T1.constructorId = T3.constructorId WHERE T3.name = 'McLaren' AND T2.year = 2013

pairs.name: freshv2-017
pairs.question: Which gas station chain has the highest total transaction amount on 2012-08-24?
pairs.sql: SELECT T2.ChainID FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' GROUP BY T2.ChainID ORDER BY SUM(T1.Price) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: freshv2-018
pairs.question: Which school had the highest average reading score among the schools in Alameda county, and how many students took the test?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.sname, T1.NumTstTakr FROM satscores AS T1 WHERE T1.cname = 'Alameda' AND T1.rtype = 'S' ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: freshv2-019
pairs.question: Which members hold an officer position and belong to the College of Education and Human Services?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.position FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' AND T1.position <> 'Member'

pairs.name: freshv2-020
pairs.question: What is the average weight of female heroes published by Marvel Comics?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

pairs.name: freshv2-021
pairs.question: List the distinct molecule identifiers whose label is negative and which contain nitrogen.
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'n' AND T2.label = '-'

pairs.name: freshv2-022
pairs.question: Who set the fastest lap at the 2012 British Grand Prix?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.name = 'British Grand Prix' AND T3.year = 2012 AND T2.rank = 1

pairs.name: freshv2-023
pairs.question: What is the average monthly gas consumption of customers in the SME segment during 2013?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(T2.Consumption) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%'

pairs.name: freshv2-024
pairs.question: What is the average number of students taking the SAT among the schools in Alameda County that enrolled more than a thousand twelfth graders?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.enroll12 > 1000

pairs.name: freshv2-025
pairs.question: Which heroes are rated above 80 on both intelligence and strength?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name IN ('Intelligence','Strength') AND T2.attribute_value > 80 GROUP BY T1.id HAVING COUNT(*) = 2

pairs.name: freshv2-026
pairs.question: What is the average pit stop duration for the race named German Grand Prix in 2011?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.duration) FROM pitStops AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.name = 'German Grand Prix' AND T2.year = 2011

pairs.name: freshv2-027
pairs.question: What is the ratio of double bonds to single bonds in the molecule TR015?
pairs.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bond AS T1 WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR015'

pairs.name: freshv2-028
pairs.question: Which counties have an average percentage of free meal eligible students above 60 percent, counting only schools with at least five hundred enrolled, and what is that average?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.`County Name`, AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm AS T1 WHERE T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` >= 500 GROUP BY T1.`County Name` HAVING AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) > 0.6

pairs.name: freshv2-029
pairs.question: Which members hold an office and are enrolled in a humanities programme?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.position FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' AND T1.position IN ('President','Vice President')

pairs.name: freshv2-030
pairs.question: For each molecule label, how many distinct molecules contain a nitrogen atom and none contain oxygen?
pairs.sql: SELECT T2.label, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'n' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atom AS T3 WHERE T3.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id AND T3.element = 'o') GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY T2.label

pairs.name: freshv2-031
pairs.question: Which budgets belong to guest speaker events and are still open?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.budget_id, T1.category FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.type = 'Guest Speaker' AND T1.event_status = 'Open'

pairs.name: freshv2-032
pairs.question: Which heroes share the same eye colour as Batman and are published by DC Comics?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN superhero AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.eye_colour_id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.superhero_name = 'Batman' AND T3.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

pairs.name: freshv2-033
pairs.question: For each label, how many distinct molecules contain a sulphur atom?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.label, COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 's' GROUP BY T1.label

pairs.name: freshv2-034
pairs.question: How many transactions were made at premium gas stations by customers with a Spanish currency account?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'Premium' AND T3.Currency = 'EUR'

pairs.name: freshv2-035
pairs.question: Which symptom appears most often among patients whose diagnosis mentions SLE?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.Symptoms FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: freshv2-036
pairs.question: For each school type, what is the average enrollment and how many schools are there?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.`School Type`, AVG(T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS avg_enrollment, COUNT(*) AS n_schools FROM frpm AS T1 GROUP BY T1.`School Type` ORDER BY n_schools DESC

pairs.name: freshv2-037
pairs.question: Which members enrolled in the College of Engineering have never attended an event?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.college = 'College of Engineering' AND T1.member_id NOT IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attendance)

pairs.name: freshv2-038
pairs.question: How many labelled molecules contain a bromine atom, grouped by their label?
pairs.sql: SELECT T2.label, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'br' GROUP BY T2.label

pairs.name: freshv2-039
pairs.question: For each nationality with at least five drivers, what is the youngest driver's date of birth and how many drivers does it have?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.nationality, MIN(T1.dob) AS youngest, COUNT(*) AS n_drivers FROM drivers AS T1 WHERE T1.dob IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.nationality HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY n_drivers DESC

pairs.name: freshv2-040
pairs.question: Which customers consumed more than 2000 units of gas in 2012, what is their segment and their total consumption?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Segment, SUM(T1.Consumption) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date LIKE '2012%' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID HAVING SUM(T1.Consumption) > 2000

pairs.name: freshv2-041
pairs.question: What is the average number of free meals and the average percentage eligible for elementary schools with at least five hundred students?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)`), AVG(T1.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm AS T1 WHERE T1.`School Type` = 'Elementary Schools (Public)' AND T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` >= 500

pairs.name: freshv2-042
pairs.question: How many schools in Alameda County are active and have more than five hundred students enrolled?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.StatusType = 'Active' AND T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500

pairs.name: freshv2-043
pairs.question: Which members spent more than the average expense?
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member WHERE T1.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

pairs.name: freshv2-044
pairs.question: Which heroes have combat rated above 70?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Combat' AND T2.attribute_value > 70

pairs.name: freshv2-045
pairs.question: List the five schools in San Diego county with the highest average mathematics score among schools that reported one.
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 WHERE T1.cname = 'San Diego' AND T1.rtype = 'S' AND T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 5

pairs.name: freshv2-046
pairs.question: List the schools in Los Angeles County with more than one thousand students enrolled.
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.School FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 1000

pairs.name: freshv2-047
pairs.question: How many distinct atoms of sulphur are there, and in how many molecules do they occur?
pairs.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) AS molecules FROM atom AS T1 WHERE T1.element = 's'

pairs.name: freshv2-048
pairs.question: What is the heaviest hero published by Marvel Comics?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' ORDER BY T1.weight_kg DESC LIMIT 1

pairs.name: freshv2-049
pairs.question: Which molecules contain more than ten atoms and are labelled negative?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

pairs.name: freshv2-050
pairs.question: What is the average age at 2020 of patients with a diagnosis of SLE, and how many such patients are there?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(2020 - CAST(SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INT)), COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Birthday IS NOT NULL

pairs.name: freshv2-051
pairs.question: How many schools are in each funding type?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.FundingType, COUNT(*) FROM schools AS T1 GROUP BY T1.FundingType ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

pairs.name: freshv2-052
pairs.question: Which circuits hosted more than ten races?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId GROUP BY T1.circuitId HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

pairs.name: freshv2-053
pairs.question: Which customer segments bought fuel at the premium stations in the sample?
pairs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN gasstations AS T3 ON T1.GasStationID = T3.GasStationID WHERE T3.Segment = 'Premium'

pairs.name: freshv2-054
pairs.question: Which events were held in the same month as the March Meeting, and how many members attended each of them?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.event_name, COUNT(T2.link_to_member) AS attendees FROM event AS T1 LEFT JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_date LIKE '2020-03%' AND T1.event_name <> 'March Meeting' GROUP BY T1.event_id ORDER BY attendees DESC

pairs.name: freshv2-055
pairs.question: Which molecules contain exactly three atoms of chlorine and at least one atom of carbon?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 WHERE T1.element = 'cl' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 3 AND T1.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c')

pairs.name: freshv2-056
pairs.question: For each county, how many schools have an enrollment above five hundred students?
pairs.sql: SELECT T1.County, COUNT(*) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500 GROUP BY T1.County

pairs.name: freshv2-057
pairs.question: Among patients with SLE, what is the average number of days between their first visit and their examination?
pairs.sql: SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(T3.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T1.`First Date`)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
